mapper.insert: insert into category ( user_id, name, type, create_time ) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{type},#{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, type, create_time from category where user_id = #{userId} and name = #{name} and type = #{type}
select id, user_id, name, type from category where type = #{type} order by name
select id, user_id, name, type from category where type = #{type} and user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
